description: An original cute feminine plush desk-cat character voice. Soft, light, rounded mezzo soprano with a small warm smile in every phrase. Gentle playful rises and falls, affectionate tiny pauses, cozy and reassuring. Sweet clear conversational speech, softly energetic, relaxed and close. No whispering, no singing, no meowing.
text: Hello, I'm here with you. Let's take one small step together. A little focus, a little rest. You're doing well.
